bio: This Auberge alongside the former Route Nationale 6 is really inviting on account of its quaint interior decorated with various agricultural items and its rustic-style furnishings. When it comes to the food, tradition is the name of the game: country-style calf's head; lamb kidney fricassee; tournedos with morels, and, on top of that, service with a smile. An enjoyable mealtime experience. Pleasant terrace to the rear....
